findings.what: The tour's Walkthrough and Commit stops link to the first node that has a walkthrough, not to the node of the rule the Rule stop opens, though the copy says 'the commits of its node'.
findings.why: NAV-5 asks for a path through one rule end to end. rule.matrix.node and plan are in TraceRule, so stops 3 to 5 could follow the same rule. On the real trail the Rule stop opens the first built rule and the Walkthrough stop opens an unrelated node. The signed-off reference also links unrelated pages (GET-1 with F3), so this doesn't block the node.

findings.what: Only the hrefs of the Overview and Requirements matrix stops are pinned. The Rule, Walkthrough and Commit stop targets have no test, so R1's mismatch goes unseen.
findings.why: web-testing: a behaviour test proves the node's flows. The computed hrefs of stops 3 to 5 are the only data-driven part of the tour, and nothing tests them.

findings.what: The page draws 'commits per agent' as a gap ('this page's data holds ... not commits'), but trace.json's commits[] carries each commit's Agent trailer, so the figure could be computed.
findings.why: The STATS-1 row names commits per agent, attempts per node and elapsed time. The build follows the signed-off G4 stats screen, which draws both as gaps, and that screen is the contract. Whether the gap stands is David's call at pause 2. It isn't U5's to change.

findings.what: The reference's 'Sort the table by its first column' action (sortable Node column, aria-sort) isn't built. The DataTable gets no sortable column and no sort or onSortChange.
findings.why: docs/ui/derived/U5/stats/screen.json lists the sort as an action, and populated.html draws the header as a sort button with aria-sort. The structural parity checks don't look at it.

findings.what: DAG task t1 names a compiler unit test for the harness file. No AGENT-3 unit test exists, as the tester noted in gate.red.
findings.why: ui.dag.yaml U5 t1: 'unit tests (compiler: context snapshots, the harness file, delivery stats)'. The pass-through may be covered by the earlier DATA-7 tests, but the node's own rule has no compiler-level test.

findings.what: Dead test support: rowOf, mainText, the rowTexts re-export and route.plan aren't used by any U5 spec.
findings.why: This is code-quality slop: unused members. The same kind of finding already sits in U7 for U0b's support file (W1 review A4 R1).

notes: TDD order holds: the red commits 8357ddc (CTX-1), 06a2946 (AGENT-3), 8292894 (STATS-1) and 5f86ded (NAV-5), plus the regression specs in 4041673, all come before the greens 3798cc3 and 2452488. Stub-proofing: the behaviour assertions use values that exist only in the U5 overlay fixture (2026-10-18T16:00:00Z verdict stamps, 'David opens the stub routes at pause 1', tree a1b2c3d, guard-agent.mjs G1), not values from the design fixture. A page canned from the derived reference can't pass them.

The AGENT-3 gaps (preloaded skills and never-dos per agent) and the STATS-1 gaps (commits per agent, elapsed time) match the signed-off G4 screens, which draw them as gaps because the harness file and the screen's data don't hold them. I counted the rules as met against that contract and raised the commits-per-agent point as R3 for David.
